root_cause: Low voltage during the wakeup sequence caused a BCP reset. UCAP-10 and the gateway subsequently reported communication faults.
corrective_action: Validate battery voltage, BCP reset reason, CAN recovery timing and wakeup sequencing.
content: Observed BCP reset during low-voltage wakeup. UCAP-10 lost communication with BCP and the gateway recorded CAN disturbances within 4 seconds. Root cause was low voltage during wakeup causing the BCP reset. Fix adjusted power-state recovery and communication timing.

root_cause: Delayed CAN wakeup timing caused temporary routing loss.
corrective_action: Adjust gateway wakeup and recovery timers; compare network traces before and after the fix.
content: Gateway communication timeout was reproduced during startup. CAN routing became available after UCAP-10 diagnostic supervision started. Timing adjustment resolved the communication loss.

corrective_action: BCP low-voltage wakeup recovery and gateway communication timing were improved.
content: Release 25-06-957 includes a fix for BCP wakeup under low-voltage conditions and improved gateway routing availability during startup.

root_cause: Multiple possible causes; documentation is not a confirmed RCA.
corrective_action: Check target ECU power, reset reason, network availability, wiring and communication timing.
content: U010000 indicates loss of communication with a target control module. Investigate target ECU power and reset state first, then network availability, communication timing and physical-layer integrity.
